create_count_tokens_handler: create an OpenAICountTokensHandler to count tokens via the OpenAI Responses API input_tokens endpoint
run_handle_count_tokens_request: run handle_count_tokens_request on the handler with a model name, input text, and API key to get input token count
test_validate_request: test the validate_request method to ensure model and input parameters are valid before token counting
build_transform_request_to_count_tokens: build the transformed request body for token counting by calling transform_request_to_count_tokens with model, input, and optional tools
review_get_openai_count_tokens_endpoint: review the get_openai_count_tokens_endpoint method to determine the correct API endpoint URL for token counting
